text:
We have spoken words,

words to wake the dead,

words to make a fire,

words where we could sit down

and smile.

We have created the sermon

of bird and sea,

the sermon of water,

the sermon of love.

We have knelt

and adored vast phrases

like the sigh of the star,

phrases like waves,

phrases with wings.

We have invented new names

for wine and for laughter,

for gazes and their terrible

paths.

I now am alone

-like the delirious miser

on her mountain of gold-

throwing words toward the sky,

but I am alone

and cannot tell my beloved

those words by which I live.

translation.title: Ashes
translation.editorial_note: The translation keeps the communal we giving way to the solitary I at the end.
